paragraphs: I'm a software engineer with 3+ years of experience building backend systems and production ML, mostly in Python and Java. At Ally Financial I work on a real-time fraud detection platform, which I helped build from the ground up. Before that, I shipped Java/Spring Boot features to a core banking platform at TCS and led its zero-downtime Oracle → PostgreSQL migration. I have an MS in Computer Science from UMass Boston (2025).
I lean backend, and I like proof: every project below comes with the numbers that show it works, and with what those numbers don't show.
Software Developer · Ally Financial · 07/2025 – present · Remote Real-time fraud detection: fraud losses −18% in the first quarter after launch
features: Helped build a real-time fraud detection platform from the ground up, and own core parts of how transactions are scored as they happen. In its first quarter, fraud losses fell by 18%.
Cut the average response time of transaction scoring from 340 ms to 265 ms by tuning database queries and connection handling.
Built a live fraud analytics dashboard that replaced spreadsheets analysts were updating by hand, cutting average investigation time by 21%.
Added LLM-written explanations for flagged activity, with guardrails and validation so every explanation meets regulatory audit requirements.
Set up the delivery pipeline and production monitoring, so on-call engineers pinpoint issues in minutes instead of hours.
